h1: Custom Baseball Outerwear for Teams & Events
metaDescription: Order custom baseball outerwear for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing on jackets, vests & more.
introHtml: Custom baseball outerwear goes beyond dugout style. Whether you need warm-up jackets for a tournament or branded vests for a company softball league, these pieces combine team identity with practical layering. The Men's Mercer+Mettle™ Puffy Vest, for example, offers lightweight insulation and a full-zip front, ideal for cool evenings at the field. Decorate with screen-printed logos or embroidered team names for a professional look that stands out in the stands.
heroAltText: Custom baseball outerwear featuring a team logo on a puffy vest for field use
